title: Power Apps: model-driven apps as Business Applications in Work IQ
summary: The licensing model needs to distinguish metered experiences from licensed Copilot Chat, where business-data grounding is included rather than charged as a Work IQ API interaction. The roadmap facts, qualified defaults and documented controls are supported; the App Access route and the supporting REST citation need minor corrections.
